canonical_period_rule: strftime(fecha, '%Y-%m') where fecha = Fecha de Transaccion parsed as ISO8601 (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS) with America/Santiago timezone, no conversion, date truncated to month
timezone_policy: No timezone conversion; source dates are local America/Santiago; stored as DATE without time; UTC shift prohibited; verification shows 0 UNINTENDED_TIMEZONE_PERIOD_SHIFTS
date_normalization: pd.to_datetime(value, errors='coerce') with no dayfirst ambiguity (ISO); for non-ISO fallback, dayfirst=False (monthfirst) prohibited for sales – must be ISO
fallback_policy: If Fecha de Transaccion is null or invalid, transaction is rejected (no silent fallback to filename, ingestion_date, or billing range). Fallback silently PROHIBIDO.
